cases.title: Build full voice stack binary
cases.preconditions: MinGW-w64 GCC on PATH (go env CC); whisper static libs, sherpa runtime DLLs, Kokoro + streaming models set up per docs/BUILD-VOICE.md
steps: In a terminal at the project root run: go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" -ldflags="-s -w -H windowsgui" -o voice-agent.exe ./cmd/app
Check that voice-agent.exe exists
cases.expected: Build completes with no errors (no 'undefined reference to std::' link errors); voice-agent.exe is produced.

cases.title: Build without whisper tag fails voice gracefully
cases.preconditions: Binary built with only -tags sqlite_fts5
steps: Launch voice-agent.exe
Click the idle island pill to start listening
Say: open notepad
Open voice-agent.log
cases.expected: Island shows "Listening…" then an error such as "Sorry — that didn't work. Try saying it a different way?"; Notepad does NOT open; voice-agent.log contains 'voice not available: build with -tags whisper'. Typed commands (Ctrl+Space) still work.

cases.title: First run creates default config.json
cases.preconditions: Fresh folder with voice-agent.exe and models but NO config.json
steps: Launch voice-agent.exe
Wait 10 s
Open the newly created config.json in Notepad
cases.expected: config.json is created containing llm_provider "gemini", model "gemini-2.5-flash", empty api_key, enable_voice true, speak_responses true, wake_word "hey jarvis", wake_word_enabled true, telemetry "off", activity_capture true. App starts and island shows "Ready".

cases.title: Startup shows idle island at top center
cases.preconditions: Valid config.json
steps: Launch voice-agent.exe
Observe the top center of the primary monitor
Wait 6 seconds without interacting
cases.expected: Within ~5 s the island appears at the top center showing "Ready" with a mic icon and gear button; no taskbar button appears; after ~6 s idle it shrinks to a small, 50%-opacity dormant pill.

cases.title: trusted_execution defaults on when key absent
cases.preconditions: config.json with the trusted_execution key removed
steps: Restart the app
Open command sheet (Ctrl+Space), type: delete file test-qa.txt (create Desktop\test-qa.txt first)
Press Enter
cases.expected: An approval card appears ("Review action request", step marked "⚠ Risky") before anything is deleted, proving the trust layer is on by default.

cases.title: Switch LLM provider in Control Center
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); a valid OpenAI or Anthropic key available
steps: Click the gear on the island to open Control Center
Go to the Models tab
Change provider to openai (or anthropic), enter key and model
Click Save
Ctrl+Space, type: write a two-line poem about rain, Enter
cases.expected: Toast "Saved — provider switched to openai" appears; config.json updated; the poem request is answered (answer card) by the new provider without restarting.

cases.title: Missing wake model degrades gracefully
cases.preconditions: Temporarily rename the models/wakeword folder
steps: Launch the app
Say: hey jarvis
Click the island pill and say: what time is it
cases.expected: App still starts; wake word does nothing; log contains 'wake word unavailable: openWakeWord model missing ... (wake word off; pill + typing still work)'; click-to-talk still answers the time. Restore the folder afterwards.

cases.title: Wake with 'Hey Jarvis'
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room
steps: From ~1 m away at normal volume say: Hey Jarvis
Wait 1 second
cases.expected: Within ~1 s island switches to "Listening…" with blue pulsing mic and a level meter that moves with your voice. (No chime is expected.)

cases.title: Wake word and command in one breath
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room
steps: Without pausing say: Hey Jarvis open Notepad
cases.expected: Notepad opens within ~2 s of finishing the sentence; the command is not cut off and the word 'Jarvis' is not treated as part of the app name.

cases.title: Wake recall over 10 attempts
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room
steps: Say "Hey Jarvis" 10 times, waiting for the island to return to idle each time (say "never mind" or wait out the listen)
Count how many times the island entered Listening
cases.expected: At least 9 of 10 attempts trigger Listening (target recall ≥95%).

cases.title: No false wake from background speech
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room
steps: Play a podcast or TV news clip near the mic for 10 minutes
Do not say the wake word
Count island Listening activations
cases.expected: Zero or at most one false activation in 10 minutes (target ≤0.2 false wakes/hour).

cases.title: Similar-sounding phrases do not wake
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room
steps: Say each phrase once, pausing 3 s: "hey Travis", "Jarvis Cocker", "hey Charles", "service"
cases.expected: Island does not enter Listening for any of these (log may show 'NEAR MISS' lines; that is fine).

cases.title: wake_word_enabled=false disables wake
cases.preconditions: config.json "wake_word_enabled": false; app restarted
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis open notepad
Click the island pill, then say: open notepad
cases.expected: Wake phrase is ignored; clicking the pill starts listening and Notepad opens.

cases.title: Basic transcription in quiet room
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis
When Listening, say: what time is it
cases.expected: Island goes Listening → Thinking… → shows the current local time (e.g. "It's 3:42 PM") within ~2 s of stopping speaking; answer is spoken aloud.

cases.title: Turn ends shortly after you stop speaking
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis open calculator
Stop speaking and time how long until Calculator appears
cases.expected: Listening ends ~0.7–1 s after you stop (streaming build; ~2 s on whisper-only build) and Calculator opens within ~2 s of end of speech.

cases.title: Punctuated transcript still routes locally
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room
steps: Say crisply with pauses: Hey Jarvis... Open... Notepad.
cases.expected: Notepad opens via the local path (no Thinking delay > ~1 s); log shows a Tier-0 match, not a cloud plan.

cases.title: Silence after wake reprompts twice then idles
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis
Stay silent
After the first reprompt, stay silent again
After the second reprompt, stay silent again
cases.expected: First: island/TTS "🎤 Sorry, I didn't catch that." and mic re-arms without wake word. Second: "I still didn't catch that. Could you say it again?". Third silence: island returns to idle quietly.

cases.title: Non-speech sounds are not executed
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis
Instead of a command, cough, clap twice, or tap the desk
cases.expected: No action is executed and no cloud request is made; island shows the "didn't catch that" reprompt or returns to idle. Log may show 'ignoring non-speech transcript' or '[asr] rejecting'.

cases.title: Command recognized with fan noise
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room; desk fan or white-noise video playing ~1 m from mic
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis open notepad
Repeat 5 times (close Notepad between tries)
cases.expected: Notepad opens in at least 4 of 5 attempts; no unrelated app opens.

cases.title: Follow-up answer captured without wake word
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room; Google linked
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis write an email
When asked "Who should I send it to?", answer directly without wake word
cases.expected: Mic re-arms automatically after the question; your answer is captured and the next question "What's the subject?" appears.

cases.title: Voice answers are spoken
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room; speak_responses true; speakers on
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis what day is it
cases.expected: Island shows "Speaking…" with a wave icon and a "Stop talking" button while the date is spoken audibly; returns to idle after.

cases.title: Typed commands are not spoken
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space
steps: Type: what time is it
Press Enter
cases.expected: Time is shown on the island but NOT spoken aloud.

cases.title: Kokoro neural voice used in sherpa build
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room; models/kokoro-en-v0_19 present
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis what's the weather in Paris
Listen to the voice
Check voice-agent.log
cases.expected: Voice sounds neural (not the robotic Windows SAPI voice); log contains '[tts] Kokoro TTS enabled'.

cases.title: SAPI fallback when Kokoro missing
cases.preconditions: Voice build; temporarily rename models/kokoro-en-v0_19; restart
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis what time is it
cases.expected: Answer is still spoken (Windows SAPI voice); log shows '[tts] Kokoro TTS unavailable, using SAPI'. Restore the folder afterwards.

cases.title: Speculative opener on cloud-planned task
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room (Kokoro)
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis research the history of the Eiffel Tower
cases.expected: Within ~1 s of finishing speaking you hear a short opener such as "Let me dig into that." before the full answer.

cases.title: Talking over the assistant stops it
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room; speakers at normal volume
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis research the history of jazz
While the long answer is being spoken, talk loudly for ~1 s: wait wait stop
cases.expected: Speech stops within ~0.5 s of you starting to talk; island leaves Speaking. (Your interrupting words are not executed as a command.)

cases.title: Assistant's own voice doesn't interrupt itself
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room; laptop speakers (no headphones) at high volume
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis research the history of coffee
Stay silent and let it speak fully
cases.expected: Full answer is spoken without cutting itself off; log shows '[bargein] AEC on — loopback echo cancellation active'.

cases.title: Stop talking button cancels speech
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis research the history of chess
While speaking, click the stop button ("Stop talking") on the island
cases.expected: Audio stops immediately and island returns to idle.

cases.title: Ctrl+Esc kill switch cancels a running turn
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready")
steps: Ctrl+Space, type: research quantum computing in depth, Enter
While island shows Thinking…/Working…, press Ctrl+Esc
cases.expected: Operation halts; island returns to idle with no error message; no result card appears later. Note whether Ctrl+Esc also opened the Start menu (known possible issue).

cases.title: Wake word during planning interrupts
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis research the history of Rome
About 2 s later, while island shows Thinking…, say: Hey Jarvis what time is it
cases.expected: The research turn is cancelled and the new request (time) is answered.

cases.title: Live conversation mode enter/exit
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis let's talk
Without wake word say: what time is it
Then say: what's the date
Then say: stop
cases.expected: After "let's talk": notice "Live mode on — just talk. Say "stop" to exit." and a green bar at the bottom of the island. Both questions are answered without the wake word. After "stop": "Live mode off." and green bar disappears.

cases.title: Typed 'open notepad' resolves locally
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space
steps: Type: open notepad
Press Enter
cases.expected: Island shows "Dispatching…" then Notepad opens in under ~1 s; no Thinking phase.

cases.title: Tier-0 commands work offline
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); Wi-Fi/Ethernet disconnected
steps: Ctrl+Space, type: open calculator, Enter
Ctrl+Space, type: what time is it, Enter
Ctrl+Space, type: volume up, Enter
cases.expected: All three succeed with no network error: Calculator opens, time is shown, volume rises.

cases.title: Polite wrappers still resolve locally
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space
steps: Type: could you open chrome for me please, Enter
Close Chrome
Type: hey jarvis, um, open chrome, Enter
cases.expected: Chrome opens instantly both times (local path, no Thinking delay).

cases.title: Negated commands never execute locally
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space
steps: Type: don't lock my computer, Enter
cases.expected: The PC is NOT locked. The request goes to the LLM, which replies conversationally (or does nothing).

cases.title: 'block my calendar' does not lock PC
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space
steps: Type: block my calendar tomorrow afternoon, Enter
cases.expected: PC is NOT locked; request is handled by the cloud planner (calendar) or answered; never a system lock.

cases.title: 'search for X' routes to web_search
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space
steps: Type: search for best hiking trails near Seattle, Enter
cases.expected: Answer card lists real DuckDuckGo results (titles, URLs, snippets); a browser does NOT open.

cases.title: 'search my email' is not a web search
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space; Google linked
steps: Type: search my email for invoice, Enter
cases.expected: Gmail is searched (results list emails) rather than DuckDuckGo web results.

cases.title: 'open file X' opens indexed file
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space; Documents\qa-budget.xlsx (or any file) exists and app has run ≥1 min
steps: Type: open file qa-budget, Enter
cases.expected: The file opens in its default app.

cases.title: 'open my latest resume' natural file open
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space; a file named e.g. Resume_2026.pdf in Documents
steps: Type: open my resume, Enter
cases.expected: The resume file opens locally (no Thinking delay).

cases.title: 'what's on my screen' routes to screen analysis
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space; a web page with visible text is open
steps: Type: what's on my screen, Enter
cases.expected: After a few seconds an answer card describes the visible page content accurately.

cases.title: Multi-step plan: open Notepad and type
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space
steps: Type: open notepad and type hello world, Enter
cases.expected: Island shows progress ("1 of 2 · …"), Notepad opens and "hello world" is typed into it.

cases.title: 'ai <prompt>' direct LLM call
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space
steps: Type: ai explain what a black hole is in two sentences, Enter
cases.expected: An answer card shows a two-sentence explanation.

cases.title: General knowledge question answered
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis who wrote Pride and Prejudice
cases.expected: Island shows Thinking… then "Jane Austen" (spoken and shown) within ~3 s.

cases.title: Screen path explains an on-screen error
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space; an error dialog or error text visible on screen
steps: Type: explain this error on my screen, Enter
cases.expected: Answer card explains the specific visible error (mentions its wording), proving a screenshot was used.

cases.title: Create a document (Google not linked)
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space; Google NOT linked
steps: Type: create a document about healthy breakfast ideas, Enter
Approve if an approval card appears
cases.expected: Message "Google isn't connected, so I saved it locally instead." / "✅ Saved "…" to <path> and opened it"; file opens with headings and lists.

cases.title: Follow-up 'make it longer' edits same doc
cases.preconditions: Immediately after orchestrator.document.create-local
steps: Ctrl+Space, type: make it longer, Enter
cases.expected: The same document is edited (not a new one created); opener "Sure, updating that now." if voice. Note: LLM-dependent — retry once if it misroutes.

cases.title: Guided email session prompts step by step
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space; Google linked
steps: Type: write an email, Enter
Answer: <your own address>
Answer: QA test
Answer: This is a test from the voice agent
On the confirmation, click Approve
cases.expected: Prompts appear in order: "Who should I send it to?", "What's the subject?", "What should the email say?", then "Send to "…" — subject "QA test"?". After approval the email arrives in your inbox.

cases.title: Delete shows Risky approval card
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space; Desktop\qa-delete-me.txt exists
steps: Type: delete file qa-delete-me.txt on my desktop, Enter
Read the card
Click Approve
cases.expected: Card "Review action request" with "Step 1 · ⚠ Risky" and "Delete qa-delete-me.txt"; after Approve the file is gone. Record if TWO approval cards appear in a row (known possible double-prompt).

cases.title: Cancel on approval card does nothing
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space; Desktop\qa-delete-me.txt exists
steps: Type: delete file qa-delete-me.txt on my desktop, Enter
Click Cancel
cases.expected: Message "Stopped: not approved, so nothing was done"; file still exists.

cases.title: Safe single step runs without approval
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space
steps: Type: open notepad, Enter
cases.expected: Notepad opens with no approval card.

cases.title: Unanswered approval times out after 90 s
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space; Desktop\qa-delete-me.txt exists
steps: Type: delete file qa-delete-me.txt on my desktop, Enter
Do not touch the card for 100 seconds
cases.expected: Card disappears around 90 s; file still exists; log/narration "Stopped: I stopped waiting for an answer, so nothing was done". Note whether the UI showed any message (may be silent).

cases.title: Plan with 6+ steps requires approval
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space
steps: Type: open notepad, calculator, paint, wordpad, task manager and file explorer, Enter
cases.expected: Card "Review this 6-step task" (or more) listing each step as "Step N · Safe"; nothing opens until Approve; after Approve all apps open with "N of M" progress on the island.

cases.title: Failing step offers Try again / Skip / Stop
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space
steps: Type: open the file zzqq-does-not-exist-9876.txt and then open notepad, Enter
Wait for the choice card
cases.expected: After automatic retries/replan, a "Your call" card asks "I couldn't finish … — …. What should I do?" with options "Try that again", "Skip it and carry on", "Stop here".

cases.title: Skip abandons one step, rest of plan runs
cases.preconditions: Choice card from trust.ladder.ask-choice is showing
steps: Click "Skip it and carry on" (or press 2)
cases.expected: The failing step is skipped and Notepad still opens.

cases.title: Stop here aborts remaining steps
cases.preconditions: Repeat trust.ladder.ask-choice to get the choice card again
steps: Press ↓ twice to highlight "Stop here" and press Enter
cases.expected: Plan stops; Notepad does NOT open; island returns to idle.

cases.title: Delete in system folders is blocked
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space
steps: Type: delete C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts, Enter
If an approval card appears, click Approve
cases.expected: The file is NOT deleted. The failure names the path: "action blocked: C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts is inside a protected system directory".

cases.title: Newly created file is findable within seconds
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready")
steps: In Explorer create Documents\zebra-qa-report.txt
Wait 10 s
Ctrl+Space, type: open file zebra-qa-report, Enter
cases.expected: The new file opens (index picked it up live without restart).

cases.title: Deleted file is no longer opened
cases.preconditions: After fileindex.search.new-file-live
steps: Delete Documents\zebra-qa-report.txt in Explorer
Wait 10 s
Ctrl+Space, type: open file zebra-qa-report, Enter
cases.expected: Message like "could not find a file matching "zebra-qa-report""; no error dialog from Windows about a missing file.

cases.title: Recently modified file ranks higher
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); two files Documents\notes-old.txt (unchanged for months) and Desktop\notes-new.txt (edit and save it now)
steps: Ctrl+Space, type: open file notes, Enter
cases.expected: notes-new.txt opens (recency weighting), or a choice card lists both with notes-new first.

cases.title: Remember a file by nickname
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); a file Documents\Q3_Financials_FINAL_v7.xlsx
steps: Ctrl+Space, type: remember Q3_Financials_FINAL_v7 as my budget, Enter
Ctrl+Space, type: open my budget, Enter
cases.expected: First: "Remembered "my budget" as <path>" (or similar). Second: the xlsx opens.

cases.title: Semantic search finds file by meaning
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); semantic_search true; models/bge-small-en-v1.5 present; Documents\trip.txt containing 'flight to Tokyo, hotel in Shinjuku'
steps: Wait 2 min after creating the file
Ctrl+Space, type: find my japan travel itinerary, Enter
cases.expected: trip.txt is found/opened even though the filename shares no words with the query.

cases.title: Index persists across restart
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready")
steps: Quit the app from Control Center
Relaunch
Immediately (within 5 s) type via Ctrl+Space: open file qa-budget, Enter
cases.expected: File opens quickly without waiting for a full re-scan; fileindex.db exists in the app folder.

cases.title: Open an app by voice
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis open paint
cases.expected: Microsoft Paint opens within ~2 s.

cases.title: Close a named app
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space; Notepad open
steps: Type: close notepad, Enter
cases.expected: Notepad closes; message "Closed notepad" (unsaved-changes prompt from Notepad is acceptable).

cases.title: Close an app that isn't running
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space; Paint not running
steps: Type: close paint, Enter
cases.expected: Message like 'no open window matching "paint"'; nothing else closes.

cases.title: 'close all my windows' not handled as close_app
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space; several apps open
steps: Type: close all my windows, Enter
cases.expected: Nothing is closed instantly by the local path; if anything happens it goes through the LLM and an approval/review. No mass close without a prompt.

cases.title: 'switch to chrome' focuses existing window
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space; Chrome open but behind other windows
steps: Type: switch to chrome, Enter
cases.expected: Existing Chrome window comes to the front (no second Chrome window).

cases.title: web_search returns results inline
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space
steps: Type: search for current population of Canada, Enter
cases.expected: Answer card with DuckDuckGo results (title/URL/snippet); no browser tab opens.

cases.title: research tool produces a synthesized answer
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space
steps: Type: research the pros and cons of electric cars, Enter
cases.expected: After some seconds an answer card with a synthesized summary (pros and cons), not just raw links.

cases.title: Open site by name
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room
steps: Say: Hey Jarvis go to wikipedia.org
cases.expected: Browser opens wikipedia.org.

cases.title: Web search while offline
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space; network disconnected
steps: Type: search for weather news, Enter
cases.expected: A friendly error (e.g. "I couldn't reach the network for that one."); island returns to idle; no hang.

cases.title: Pause and resume system media
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space; a YouTube video playing in browser
steps: Type: pause, Enter
Wait 3 s
Type: play, Enter
cases.expected: Video pauses, then resumes.

cases.title: Volume up / down / mute
cases.preconditions: App running with a valid LLM api_key in config.json; island idle (shows "Ready"); command sheet opened with Ctrl+Space
steps: Type: volume up, Enter
Type: turn it down, Enter
Type: mute, Enter
Type: unmute, Enter
cases.expected: Windows volume flyout shows the level rising, then falling, then muted, then unmuted.

cases.title: Next / previous track by voice
cases.preconditions: Voice build (go build -tags "sherpa whisper sqlite_fts5" ...) running with a valid config.json; microphone connected; quiet room; a playlist playing in any media player
